item.title: Kushner meets Hamas leaders to discuss Gaza disarmament
item.description: President Trump's envoy Jared Kushner met Hamas leaders in Egypt on Sunday to urge them to fulfill their commitment to disarm, according to two sources.

item.title: AI could make top-tier health care accessible to all
item.description: The author's wife spent years in hospitals battling chronic conditions, highlighting how AI might democratize expert medical care.

item.title: Report: Trump used secret channel to Iran's Revolutionary Guard
item.description: In May, U.S. negotiators faced uncertainty about Iranian counterparts, leading to a covert backchannel with the Revolutionary Guard.

item.title: AI prompts students to reconsider college majors
